verdict.rationale: Increase documents FDIC insurance via IntraFi network banks and sweep to FDIC-insured institutions, plus the Account/Account Number architecture that lets finance teams isolate individual sub-accounts (e.g., per-investor Account Numbers), and a customer case (Ascend) confirms FBO account support. Community evidence independently confirms which underlying banks actually hold funds (First Internet Bank/Blue Ridge Bank), adding transparency Increase itself doesn't spell out as plainly. However, there's no first-party documentation on ledger access/permissions (who can see the ledger) or a clear side-by-side explanation of FBO-pool vs individual-account tradeoffs and exactly how FDIC coverage attaches per structure. Missing for 10: explicit ledger-visibility/access-control documentation, first-party (not just customer-story) explanation of FBO vs individual account structures, and precise FDIC coverage-attachment mechanics per account type.
